text:
maddie: Heads-up — prepping a regional rollout for harbor-v2 weights. Need quick async checks before we enable eu-west: weights URI + checksum, tokenizer tokenmap sanity (there's a small OOV remap quirk), and the catalog pin + fallback variant config. Can folks +1 availability?
raj: I can take weights + checksum. Which storage path?
maddie: s3://redwood-models/harbor/v2/weights.tar.gz (sha256: 4f1d3b9a...). uploading the manifest now.
luis: FYI tokenizer returns a different BOS id for some legacy sequences; it maps "<s>" -> 2 instead of 1 for a tiny subset. I put a small patch in the tokenizer adapter to normalize before encoding.
sara: pinging this for config validation: our rollout manifests should include pin -> 2.0.1, canary -> 5%, fallback -> harbor-legacy@1.8. Add region_enable: [us-west-2, eu-west-1] for now. I can run the lint.
zach: For canary traffic plan: start 5% over 2 hours, check latency+err-rate. If lat p95 <= 250ms and errors < 0.5% after 1h, increase to 20%. Rollback to fallback variant automatically on >1% errors for 10m.
maddie: thanks. sara — can you paste the exact YAML snippet you want in the catalog?
sara: sure, putting it here:
```yaml
model: harbor
version: 2.0.1
pin: true
canary: 0.05
fallback_variant: harbor-legacy@1.8
regions:
  - us-west-2
  - eu-west-1
health_checks:
  latency_p95_threshold_ms: 250
  error_rate_threshold_pct: 1.0
```
raj: weights checksum matches for weights.tar.gz. Verified locally with extraction and md5/sha256. no corruption. :thumbsup:
luis: tokenizer adapter change LGTM. Note: we should add a small test case to catch the BOS id mapping — I added one in the PR.
ops-bot: preflight results for harbor-v2:
- weights reachable: OK
- checksum: OK
- container build: OK
- kv-cache warm-path test: WARNING (cold path p50 higher than expected)
- quota checks: OK
See full run: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/harbor/v2/1234
maddie: ops-bot warning noted — raj can you try a small perf run with kv-cache warm-up?
raj: scheduling a quick perf job now, should have numbers in ~30m.
zach: also add a routing fallback rule in the policy so eu-west can route to eu-central if capacity issues. config key: route_policy.region_fallbacks.eu-west-1: [eu-central-1]
sara: lint passed except for a minor schema warning (unused field in metadata). I'll open a tiny PR to remove it.
maddie: sounds good. Once raj posts perf numbers and ops-bot rechecks, i'll kick off the canary enable. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: planned canary start scheduled: 1912354000 (UTC). Will post updates in this thread.
raj: perf run complete — kv-cache warm p95 is 120ms, cold path p50 spike is 420ms but only on startup. Agreeable for canary with dynamic warm-ups.
maddie: +1 to proceed with canary. I'll trigger at scheduled time and watch. If anyone wants rollback windows shorter than 10m speak now.
luis: fine with 10m. I can watch tokenizer metrics.
sara: I'll monitor catalog rollout dashboards and certs.
zach: I'll watch routing/region failover.
maddie: thanks — closing for now, will update once canary starts. :rocket:
